annotations.title: Lint an ad cut (joins, captions, audio, ending, length)

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Checks an ad's cut against the ad-cut rules: too many joins (warning), joins only at a rest point, no cut inside a caption or its fade, one caption layer, no audio dip at a join, exactly one ending, and the network's length / aspect / ad-text window (TikTok 9:16, 12-25 s, ad text up to 100 by default). Each finding names its fix. It reads the cut you describe (segments, captions, signals), not a rendered file; a rule with nothing to check is reported unchecked. With contentId the result is kept for that draft: a format:ad video draft is booked or filed as an ad only once its latest lint for the network passes.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/ad-cut/lint.)

adText.description: Ignored with contentId (the draft text is used).

audioEnvelope.description: Output-time `[{ atMs, db }]`, per-source `{ sourceId: [{ atMs, db }] }`, or null for no audio.

captions.description: `{ startMs, endMs, text?, layer?, fadeInMs?, fadeOutMs? }` in output ms. Omit when unknown; [] for none.

contentId.description: Keep the result for this draft (write scope).

joins.description: Extra cut points inside segments, output ms.

network.description: tiktok, x, pinterest, reddit, or a configured network.

segments.description: In order: takes `{ sourceId, inMs, outMs, includesEnding? }` or `{ kind: "end_card", durationMs }`.

signals.description: Per source: `{ motion?: [{ atMs, energy }], envelope?: [{ atMs, db }] }`, in source ms.

name: ad_cut_lint
title: Lint an ad cut (joins, captions, audio, ending, length)
